segments.an4.202:1.2: sappurisañca, sappurisena sappurisatarañca. Taṃ suṇātha … pe ….
segments.an4.202:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco assaddho hoti, ahiriko hoti, anottappī hoti, appassuto hoti, kusīto hoti, muṭṭhassati hoti, duppañño hoti.
segments.an4.202:3.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco attanā ca assaddho hoti, parañca assaddhiye [asaddhāya (ka.)] samādapeti;
segments.an4.202:3.3: attanā ca ahiriko hoti, parañca ahirikatāya samādapeti;
segments.an4.202:3.4: attanā ca anottappī hoti, parañca anottappe samādapeti;
segments.an4.202:3.5: attanā ca appassuto hoti, parañca appassute samādapeti;
segments.an4.202:3.6: attanā ca kusīto hoti, parañca kosajje samādapeti;
segments.an4.202:3.7: attanā ca muṭṭhassati hoti, parañca muṭṭhassacce [muṭṭhasacce (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] samādapeti;
segments.an4.202:3.8: attanā ca duppañño hoti, parañca duppaññatāya samādapeti.
segments.an4.202:4.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco saddho hoti, hirimā hoti, ottappī hoti, bahussuto hoti, āraddhavīriyo hoti, satimā hoti, paññavā hoti.
segments.an4.202:5.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco attanā ca saddhāsampanno hoti, parañca saddhāsampadāya samādapeti;
segments.an4.202:5.3: attanā ca hirimā hoti, parañca hirimatāya [hirisampadāya (ka.)] samādapeti;
segments.an4.202:5.4: attanā ca ottappī hoti, parañca ottappe samādapeti;
segments.an4.202:5.5: attanā ca bahussuto hoti, parañca bāhusacce samādapeti;
segments.an4.202:5.6: attanā ca āraddhavīriyo hoti, parañca vīriyārambhe samādapeti;
segments.an4.202:5.7: attanā ca upaṭṭhitassati hoti, parañca satiupaṭṭhāne [satipaṭṭhāne (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] samādapeti;
segments.an4.202:5.8: attanā ca paññāsampanno hoti, parañca paññāsampadāya samādapeti.

lines: Pāṇātipāte samādapetīti yathā pāṇaṃ atipāteti, tathā naṃ tattha gahaṇaṃ gaṇhāpeti.
Ayaṃ vuccatīti ayaṃ evarūpo puggalo yasmā sayaṃkatena ca dussīlyena samannāgato, yañca samādapitena kataṃ, tato upaḍḍhassa dāyādo, tasmā “asappurisena asappurisataro”ti vuccati.
Sappurisena sappurisataroti attanā ca katena susīlyena samannāgatattā yañca samādapito karoti, tato upaḍḍhassa dāyādattā uttamapurisena uttamapurisataro.
Ettha ca parena kataṃ dussīlyaṃ susīlyaṃ vā āṇattiyā attanā ca vacippayogena katanti āṇāpanavasena pasutapāpassa puññassa vā dāyādo “tato upaḍḍhassa dāyādo”ti vutto.
